supervision_contract.positive_coordinates: raw fit117 FrameDet z,y,x; nearest voxel only at feature-map sampling
supervision_contract.positive_identity: Adjacent GT edge whose two endpoints are mapped by patched official node matching to final prediction IDs and both IDs exist in raw FrameDet.
supervision_contract.same_frame_negative_universe: every unordered pair of distinct raw detections in each frame
supervision_contract.same_frame_negatives_optimized: every distinct raw-detection pair co-occurring in a sampled crop is passed to same_frame_separation
supervision_contract.temporal_negatives: for each raw-mapped positive source, every distinct raw next-frame detection other than its GT-mapped positive target(s); optimizer retains top-k=10
